summary: Fortress Net Lease REIT filed an 8-K reporting two routine matters: an unregistered private placement of 8,864,594 common shares across Class S, I, F-S, F-I and E for gross proceeds of roughly $94.8 million, priced at the applicable class net asset value per share as of August 31, 2026, exempt under Section 4(a)(2)/Regulation D and/or Regulation S; and a September 30, 2026 declaration of per-share distributions across all classes, payable October 1, 2026 in cash or via the distribution reinvestment plan. No special-situation event, deal terms, advisor or board recommendation is present. Watch for continued NAV-based NAV-sale fundraising and distribution coverage trends.
